title: 2026 UK ETS HSE verifier-findings QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for hospital or small emitters: how to comply

facts.fact: An independent verifier can issue verified, verified with comments, or not verified opinions.
A satisfactory verification opinion is either verified or verified with comments.
Verified-with-comments can identify unresolved non-compliances with legislation.
It can identify non-conformities with the approved monitoring plan or permit conditions.
It can identify report errors or omissions as misstatements.
It can include recommendations to improve monitoring and reporting procedures.
Misstatements, non-conformities and non-compliances should be addressed as soon as possible.
If findings cannot be resolved before verification completes, the operator must explain why to the verifier.
The verifier then assesses whether a satisfactory verification opinion can still be provided.
If no satisfactory opinion is available, the regulator will determine emissions and may recover its costs.

guard_patterns.rule: Keep non-compliance, non-conformity, misstatement and recommendation distinct.
Do not treat not-verified as satisfactory.
Preserve operator duty to address findings promptly.
Keep verifier judgement distinct from regulator determination.
Preserve regulator determination when satisfactory opinion is absent.
